verdicts.reason: Both make the same structural mistake. The headline 'Garden-fresh fizz' sits above the SOLSTICE wordmark, which reverses the brand-first reading order, and it runs into the sage circle at top right. Both also leave a large dead gap between the body copy and a shrunken can. A spreads its elements more evenly down the tall canvas, though its CTA crowds the peach circle at the bottom. B packs everything higher and leaves empty space below the CTA, and its can is slightly smaller, which makes the product feel less important.
